topic: How can cli pi (the pi CLI) natively expose Cursor and Devin subscription-backed models in its own /models picker: reusing the operator Cursor (cursor-agent) and Devin OAuth/subscription auth, adding pi provider adapters, or fronting each vendor CLI with a local OpenAI-compatible gateway. Assess technical feasibility and the Terms-of-Service and account-safety boundaries of each path, grounded in the actual pi, cursor-agent, and devin CLI surfaces (config files, auth token stores, model APIs).

focus: Pi /model picker, models.json overlay, models-store cache, auth.json, registerProvider hooks
noveltyJustification: First pass; picker command, four-layer roster, six-provider auth shape, supported API types, !command/$ENV syntax, and absence of Cursor/Devin in Pi catalog are all new.
keyQuestions: How does Pi's /model picker resolve providers and models from config files, models-store, auth.json, and custom providers, and which extension hooks could carry a Cursor/Devin-shaped source?
answeredQuestions: How does Pi's /model picker resolve providers and models from config files, models-store, auth.json, and custom providers, and which extension hooks could carry a Cursor/Devin-shaped source?

ruledOut.approach: Assume Pi already ships a built-in Cursor or Devin provider
ruledOut.reason: Installed providers.md subscription list and live auth.json contain neither vendor

focus: Cursor auth stores, api2.cursor.sh, cli-config.json, ToS 1.5, staff ruling
noveltyJustification: Staff ToS ruling, 1.5 text, cli-config.json modelParameters schema, api2.cursor.sh vs Pi API types mismatch, and absence of public completions endpoint are new.
keyQuestions: Can Cursor subscription auth (cursor-agent OAuth, CURSOR_API_KEY, ~/.cursor stores) be reused by a Pi adapter or third-party HTTP client without violating ToS or account safety?
answeredQuestions: Can Cursor subscription auth (cursor-agent OAuth, CURSOR_API_KEY, ~/.cursor stores) be reused by a Pi adapter or third-party HTTP client without violating ToS or account safety?

ruledOut.approach: Pi models.json / Oh My Pi-style Cursor provider using login tokens against api2.cursor.sh
ruledOut.reason: Staff ToS 1.5; account ban risk; personal/local-only does not change the analysis

ruledOut.approach: Local OpenAI-compatible proxy to private Cursor client endpoints
ruledOut.reason: Staff: same case as Oh My Pi
